title: Naaman Healed of Leprosy
description: The Aramean commander Naaman is healed of leprosy by bathing seven times in the Jordan River at the prophet Elisha's instruction, but Elisha's servant Gehazi is punished with leprosy for his greed.

versions.reason: [major] references: The existing story 'Gehazi's Greed and Punishment' covers verses 19-27, which are part of this narrative. The new story covers the entire chapter 5 and is the overarching narrative. They should be merged since the Gehazi episode is an integral part of Naaman's story.
